tier1.text: Cell processes are arms that reach out from a cell, and some join cells together. Bone cells called osteocytes use long processes to communicate with each other and get nutrients. Star-shaped support cells called astrocytes send processes out to nerve cells and blood vessels.

sentences.text: Cell processes are arms that reach out from a cell, and some join cells together.

quotes.quote: As the name suggests, the stratum spinosum is spiny in appearance due to the protruding cell processes that join the cells via a structure called a desmosome.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: A prolongation or process extending from a cell, e.g. a flagellum or axon.

sentences.text: Bone cells called osteocytes use long processes to communicate with each other and get nutrients.

quotes.quote: Like osteoblasts, osteocytes lack mitotic activity. They can communicate with each other and receive nutrients via long cytoplasmic processes that extend through canaliculi (singular = canaliculus), channels within the bone matrix.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: osteocyte: mature bone cells and the main cell in bone tissue
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Star-shaped support cells called astrocytes send processes out to nerve cells and blood vessels.

quotes.quote: Astrocytes have many processes extending from their main cell body (not axons or dendrites like neurons, just cell extensions). Those processes extend to interact with neurons, blood vessels, or the connective tissue covering the CNS that is called the pia mater ().
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: One cell providing support to neurons of the CNS is the astrocyte, so named because it appears to be star-shaped under the microscope
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
